intro.text: A Shin swordmaster at the Elsecaller monastery in Shinovar.

items.text: Gonda oversees the monastery's martial training and teaches its monks and students. He kept harsh discipline among the acolytes when Kaladin and Szeth passed through.

appearance.text: He has the pale skin and large-looking eyes typical of the Shin.

personality.text: Disciplined and focused, he is well suited to the martial traditions kept at the monastery.
